```yaml
name: GPU Reset Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        gpu: [mi325x]
        python-version: ["3.10"]

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Setup UV
      uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        activate-environment: true
        enable-cache: true
        github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        pip install torch torchvision torchaudio --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/nightly/cu121
        pip install pytest
        pip install -e .

    - name: Run Gluon All-Gather Tests
      run: |
        python -m pytest test_all_gather_gluon.py -v

    - name: Validate Triton All-Gather Tests
      run: |
        python -m pytest test_all_gather_triton.py -v

    - name: Check for regressions
      run: |
        echo "Verifying no regressions in existing Triton all-gather tests"
        python -m pytest test_all_gather_triton.py::test_all_gather_triton_correctness -v
```
